case.description: Wake-refined re-run of the SWB CR trim, trimmed to target C_L by rotating the inlet direction at fixed |U|.

bc.farfield: inletOutlet on inlet/topBottom/outboard, freestream direction rotated to the trim alpha

numerics.schemes_summary: steady SIMPLE, second-order upwind on momentum and turbulence, GAMG on p

convergence.criterion: 200-sample window: mean drift Cd <= 0.05 ct, Cl <= 1.0 ct, Cl span <= 1.0 ct

reference.convention: DSO basis, S_ref 1.24092 m2 and c_ref 0.39396 m, b_ref 3.6576 m. Half-wing A_ref 0.620462 m2 = S_ref/2, so half-model and full-wing coefficients coincide.

notes: First 3D run card in the project. Wake-refined re-run; see docs/r2_wake_refinement_2026-09-21.md. checkMesh fails 4 checks, the SAME 4 as the published mesh. y+ max is high (81.9) against a mean of 1.24: a localised patch sits in the log layer, which does not affect the far-field Trefftz result but IS a caveat on surface quantities, Cf especially. Tooling was shipped to the cluster ad hoc, so git_commit is the repo HEAD at card-writing time, not a commit the cluster held. Run was 3 leg(s), 70443 s wall total: argus-r2-SWB_trim.o1031780 41190s; argus-r2-SWB_trim.o1031846 10259s; argus-r2-SWB_trim.o1031882 18994s.
